newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not fully established -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not fully established -USDA.

text.p: Live Sales - compared to Wednesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, USDA said. Trade was slow, with demand and seller interest fairly light. Offerings were moderate. Confirmed - 400 Week Ago - 2,000 Year Ago - 4,400 Wk to Date- 37,300 Week Ago - 18,900 Year Ago - 19,900
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Wednesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not fully established with few sales steady.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250-1300 lbs 1.5ld 106.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 102.00-103.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 97.00-98.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs few 105.00-106.00.
For the week - 39,000 Wk ago - 18,900 Yr ago - 19,900 Steers and heifers - Live basis - firm to $0.50 higher. Carcass basis - mostly $1.00 higher.
